findings.title: Machine-local trust persistence contradicts the required repo-local acknowledgement configuration
T001 enables the judgment-only broker before T002 supplies the deterministic driver and arbitration verbs, breaking acknowledged headless ticks
Repository identity and clone, worktree, move, and replacement trust semantics are undefined and therefore unverifiable
The arbitration truth table has overlapping outcomes for mixed or malformed evidence that also contains a blocking finding
orchid start lacks criteria requiring a separate explicit trust opt-in and reason
T002 lacks focused verification that driver dispatch preserves engine neutrality and plugin contracts
The end-to-end rehearsal lacks an enforced network and external-mutation tripwire
